name: Salon (Modern)
tagline: A warm, modern-boho template for hair salons — book online from day one.
description: A modern, warm, boho hair-salon site — an oat-cream palette, a terracotta primary and a sage-green accent, with natural-light photography and a relaxed, friendly voice. Installs a working booking flow: a real service menu (cuts, curly & textured cuts, color, balayage), three stylists you book by name with their own hours, and a color-deposit policy. Ships as "Wildroot", a plant-filled little studio that specialises in curls and texture.
